name: io.github.tonyyang0504/base_jp-mcp
description: BASE (store platform) + BASE Developers API + BASE Apps supplier connectors (ecommerce suppliers): m

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BASE_JP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your app at https://developers.thebase.in/ (API application required).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BASE_JP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the same app.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BASE_JP_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from the one-time authorization-code exchange (GET /1/oauth/authorize with scope read_users read_items read_orders → POST /1/oauth/token, https://docs.thebase.in/api/oauth/access_token). Valid about 30 days and rotated on every refresh; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the rotated token survives restarts.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BASE_JP_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: The callback URL registered for your BASE Developers app; BASE requires it in every refresh-token request ('redirect_uri 登録したコールバックURL (必須)', https://docs.thebase.in/api/oauth/refresh_token).
